name: Festa Ticket Report
query:
SELECT
    YEAR(t.creation) AS "Year",
    MONTHNAME(t.creation) AS "Month",
    COUNT(t.name) AS "Total Tickets",
    ROUND(SUM(t.price), 2) AS "Total Amount"
FROM
    `tabFesta Ticket` t
LEFT JOIN
    `tabFesta Booking` b ON b.name = t.booking
WHERE
    (IFNULL(%(event)s, '') = '' OR t.event = %(event)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(year)s, 0) = 0 OR YEAR(t.creation) = %(year)s)
    AND (IFNULL(%(organizer)s, '') = '' OR b.organizer = %(organizer)s)
GROUP BY
    YEAR(t.creation),
    MONTH(t.creation)
ORDER BY
    YEAR(t.creation) DESC,
    MONTH(t.creation) DESC;
